sentences.text: Chondrenchelys was a medium-sized fish with an elongated body reaching up to 18 cm in length. It featured a long dorsal fin and a body that tapered to a sharp point.
The species name problematicus likely refers to the lack of scales, which distinguished it from other known fish at the time of discovery.
Chondrenchelys is classified in the class Chondrichthyes, the group containing cartilaginous fish.
It belongs to the family Chondrenchelyidae.
The genus Chondrenchelys was described by Traquair in 1888.
Chondrenchelys lived during the Visean stage, from 346.7 to 339.9 million years ago.
